text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't change any tests. The fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`. This also fixed the `age` error.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, which matches the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`**: `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. It now returns exactly the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books` was missing the third book, so I added `Emma` by Austen, 1815, 1 copy. The docstring and tests only say the title is `Emma`. I made up the author, year and copy count.
